metadata.title: Hopf quotients of the infinite-dimensional Gaussian pyramid
metadata.abstract: We study the infinite-dimensional Gaussian pyramid and its quotients by the global sign flip and the $U(1)$-Hopf action. We resolve affirmatively a long-standing problem posed by Tomohiro Fukaya around 2014: these three limiting geometries are pairwise non-similar, meaning that no positive rescaling makes any two of them coincide.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明无限维 Gaussian pyramid 及符号商、Hopf 商两两不相似，回应 Fukaya 的问题。
analysis.breakthrough: 区分三种无限维极限测度几何，即使允许正比例缩放。
analysis.limitations: 相似性是在 pyramid 框架中，而非普通有限维等距概念。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
analysis.aiEvidence: 致谢披露 ChatGPT 参与文稿准备，作者审阅修订并承担责任。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.07030v1（AI 声明/致谢；涉及摘要者同时核对元数据）
analysis.priorityReason: 集中极限与度量测度结构直接相关。
